HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE TUSHAR RAO GEDELA  ORDER % 11.05.2023 [ The proceeding has been conducted through Hybrid mode ]
1. This is an application seeking condonation of delay in filing the present appeal.
2. For the reasons stated in the application, the delay of 87 days in filing the present appeal is condoned.

4. This is an appeal under section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 impugning the judgment dated 07.11.2022 passed by the learned Reference Court in LAC No. 07/2018 titled as Randhir Singh (Deceased) through LRs vs. Union of India & Anr, seeking further enhancement of the compensation amount in respect of award No.12/2005-06 pertaining to the land acquired of Village Barwala, Delhi.
